description: A summary of one timeseries (length, min/max/mean, p05/p50/p95, zeros, first and last values): demand (p_set), output (p), capacity factors (p_max_pu), prices, state of charge. full: true adds up to max_points raw values.

scenario_id.description: Optional scenario id (the uuid exactly as it was shown to you) or name, or "base" for the base network. If omitted, returns the timeseries for the currently-active scenario.

name: get_component_timeseries
